reason: The README clearly describes a multimodal bridge whose primary user-facing purpose is image understanding, OCR, analysis, and image generation through Qwen-backed MCP and DeepSeek Harness tools.

summaries.en: Provides Qwen-backed image understanding, OCR, image analysis, and text-to-image generation through MCP or DeepSeek Harness.
